checklist: clear (TERM=xterm-256color) exits 0 and writes ESC[H ESC[2J ESC[3J (bytes compared)
bash -c 'clear && echo …' runs the second command
TERM=screen-256color clear works from the shipped database (TERMINFO via slicc.env)
TERM=dumb clear: no output, rc 1 (ncurses behaviour)
unknown TERM: clear → "unknown terminal type", tput → rc 3
tput setaf 1 → ESC[31m; tput sgr0; tput colors → 256
tput cols / tput lines on a 123x45 pty → 123 / 45
reset on a pty returns 0 and the shell carries on (tput cols afterwards)
needsNote: TERMINFO=${package}/share/terminfo comes from slicc.env; xterm-256color, xterm, vt100 and dumb are also compiled-in fallbacks (as in wasm-less / wasm-bash, which need no database).
